SP-001.2: Recorded 2026-11-08 with scripts/hook-capture.sh, Claude Code 2.1.309, headless `claude -p` sessions in a scratch project (user approved headless runs on 2026-11-08). 13 scenarios with cwd observed in PreToolUse, CwdChanged and the next PreToolUse: C01 cd within, C02 cd outside, C03 cd x && cmd, C04 absolute path in Bash, C05 git -C, C06 Read tool outside, C07 subagent cd outside, C08 MAINTAIN_PROJECT_WORKING_DIR=1, C09 =0, C10 resume, C11 compact, C12 EnterWorktree, C14 PreToolUse deny. C13 /cd: not available in headless mode ("/cd isn't available in this environment").

Findings: (1) cd within the project: CwdChanged(old_cwd,new_cwd) fires and the next PreToolUse cwd follows. (2) cd outside the project (C02, C03, C07) or any cd with MAINTAIN_PROJECT_WORKING_DIR=1 (C08): CwdChanged fires with the new dir, then the shell is reset to the project with NO CwdChanged back; the next PreToolUse cwd is the project. CwdChanged's own cwd field was the new dir in C02 but the old dir in C07. (3) Absolute paths, git -C and Read file_path never change cwd; targets exist only in tool_input. (4) Subagent tool calls share the parent session_id and add agent_id/agent_type; a cd inside a subagent did not persist and fired no CwdChanged. (5) Resume restarts in the project root, not the last cwd (source=resume). (6) Compact: PreCompact(trigger=manual), SessionStart(source=compact), PostCompact; cwd unchanged. (7) EnterWorktree moves cwd into .claude/worktrees/<name> with NO CwdChanged. (8) PreToolUse deny (hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision=deny + reason) blocks the call; no PostToolUse follows and the model sees the reason. (9) Another PreToolUse hook (rtk) rewrote tool_input (ls -> rtk ls), visible only in PostToolUse: a guard must judge the input that actually runs.
SP-001.3: Recorded 2026-11-08 with scripts/hook-capture.sh, codex-cli 0.166.0, headless `codex exec --dangerously-bypass-hook-trust` in the scratch project (user approved the batch on 2026-11-08). Codex ignores an untrusted project's .codex/hooks.json even with the trust bypass: the first run recorded nothing until the user trusted the scratch project interactively. 10 scenarios recorded: X01 cd within, X02 cd outside, X03 cd x && cmd, X04 absolute path in shell, X05 git -C, X06 shell workdir parameter outside, X07 PreToolUse deny, X08 apply_patch on an outside path, X09 resume, X11 subagent with workdir outside. X10 /compact via `codex exec resume` did not compact (no PreCompact; the text went to the model as a prompt).

Findings: (1) Codex has no CwdChanged event (0.166 events: SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse, PermissionRequest, PostToolUse, PreCompact, PostCompact, SubagentStart, SubagentStop, Stop, SessionEnd, plus model/interrupt events). (2) Each shell call is independent: cd never persists and payload cwd stays the session root (X01-X03). (3) The shell tool's workdir parameter moves payload cwd (X06, X11: cwd=outside) while tool_input holds only `command` and the hook process still runs in the project; the guard must use payload cwd, not its own working directory. (4) Shell tool_name is `Bash`; file edits use tool_name `apply_patch` with the target path only inside tool_input.command (`*** Update File: <path>`) (X08). (5) Subagents: spawn/wait tools appear as `collaborationspawn_agent`/`collaborationwait_agent`; subagent tool calls keep the parent session_id and add agent_id/agent_type (X11). (6) Resume: SessionStart source=resume, cwd = session root (X09). (7) PreToolUse deny with hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision=deny plus a non-empty permissionDecisionReason blocks the call; no PostToolUse follows (X07). Codex rejects `ask`, a deny without a reason, and updatedInput without allow (binary strings).
